steps.content: Soon after, Nino sets up her streaming equipment in the room you specially prepared for her, ready to start.
This is just a regular gaming and chatting session, but she has done a lot of preparation.

In addition to the streaming equipment, her computer desk is covered in materials gathered beforehand. Several additional monitors display a variety of emergency responses, precautions, and a densely packed schedule specified down to the minute.
You used to think she was an improviser whose job was just to play games casually. You didn't expect her to take it so seriously.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is this how you usually prepare for your livestream?

choices.text: Is this how you usually prepare for your livestream?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Of course! Everything needs to be prepared carefully to deliver the perfect show! What, are you swooning at this serious side of me?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I see you're pretty shy. What are those people doing outside?
She turns her chair around and asks as she looks at the group of analysts setting up instruments not far outside the room.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Wow, as expected of the MBCC, even the audience is so special. Tell them not to get too close though, I'm about to start streaming!
She pouts and turns back. The stream is about to start.
You stand in the room, watching her livestream up close. The analysts nearby are also monitoring her streaming equipment.
The Nino in front of you is flamboyant, confident, yet serious. As she talks non-stop, her fingers are also dancing on the keyboard.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Uh... Lv.320 gear! Though it's not for myself, I must admit I have this thing for good gear. If I see it, I need it!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Beat you to it! Better luck next time, hehe!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Eh... My mouse is out of battery. Let me change it!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You're lucky my mouse is broken and I can't click the need button. I'll let you have this piece! You have Nino Sama's mouse to thank!
It's as if she was born knowing how to capture people's attention. Although she has a sharp tongue, she never hurts anyone.
She's even comfortable enough to be making faces at you discreetly.
An instrument near the room makes a slight beep. She may have inadvertently activated some of her power again, so you clear your throat softly.
She nods to indicate that she's heard you, but then immediately giggles and makes a surprising remark.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I've been talking for so long, I'm sooo thirsty. Hey, you, fetch me a glass of coke.
<size=28>Did you forget our first rule? You can't reveal your location!</size>

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: <size=28>Of course I remember it! Chill out!</size>

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who's she talking to?
She pays no attention to the situation and begins to read the comments.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh, I recently hired a cleaner guy. You know, the kind who's over fifty, likes to nag at people, and has no other merits than being good at his job. See, he's not even attentive enough to know to fetch me a coke.
steps.female_content: Oh, I recently hired a cleaning lady. You know, the kind who's over fifty, likes to nag at people, and has no other merits than being good at her job. See, she's not even attentive enough to know to fetch me a coke.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nino Sama is cute even when she's being savage to the elderly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I know right? Your girl's biggest selling point is her honesty!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nino is a household name now! She's no longer just another internet celebrity.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh, you flatter me too much!
And with that, she tilts up her chin at you provocatively, making a drinking gesture to urge you to fetch her a drink.
You nod silently and leave the room to bring back a cup of strong coffee from the rest area.
Still animatedly berating her teammates on the stream, Nino takes the cup without even looking and drains it in one go.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Uh, cough, cough... It's so bitter...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Where's... Where's my soda?!
Nino in the room is pounding her chest and stomping her feet like she can't wait to catch you and tear you to pieces.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Chief, welcome, please have a seat. Here's Sinner Nino's ability analysis report.
The report shows that Nino's data are average and her only strengths are her defense and stamina. Besides that...
Her M-value is visibly higher than the average. Perhaps this is why she could briefly resist the shackles? You're not sure.
What is going on?

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: We've hypothesized multiple possibilities that could have caused Sinner Nino's abnormal M-value and allowed her to convert that into combat power. The most likely scenario is...
(Scene change)
After a while, Nino comes out of the streaming room and walks over to you.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Cough...
Nino keeps coughing, and for a moment, her expression even seems somewhat pained.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you catch a cold?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm fine! I just choked on my coffee! Cough, cough... Next time, if you dare give me coffee again, I swear I'll smash you into this wall...
It seems that your little revenge on her was quite effective.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: We're just getting started. I'm known for my stamina, it's just "chair time" now.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh, by the way, will you come back to watch me stream later? Without your supervision, I can't promise I won't create a disaster!
The big-name streamer beside you looks ebullient.
Although she's generally behaved well under your watch, there are still things you want to confirm today.

steps.speaker: The situation takes a direct turn for the worse. Hecate can only order the Nightmare to retreat and wait for the next opportunity to attack.
Chief
steps.content: I'm afraid that's it for today. I have some other things to handle. You can stream for a bit longer next time.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh... I see... Well... Never mind then.
As if recalling something, Nino's expression dims and she draws back that hand extended toward you.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I guess I'll just, find some games to play on my own like I used to do...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'll just... keep playing...
Having said that, she slowly walks back to her room.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can you confirm these conclusions?

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Not 100%, but based on the data collected from this livestream, our conclusions are likely correct.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Her ability's structure is complex, and a large portion of uncontrollable Mania is triggered when she uses her ability.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Meanwhile, the excessive M-value has been accumulating for one or two years. If we don't get it under control...
Listening to the analyst, you realize that Nino's health is not looking good. Every time she uses her ability, her own M-value rises.
You flip Nino's dossier to the very front and compare it with the analysis department's conclusions this time.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Based on the analysis, her power grows with the emotions of the livestream viewers. When her and the viewers' emotions are relatively stable, her power is almost dormant.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: But once her and her fans' emotions fluctuate intensely and resonate with one another, the resulting reverberations will also multiply exponentially.
But she has already finished streaming for today. Later today, you'll need to reinforce the shackles on her again.
You have one last thing to verify.
(Scene change)
After some hesitation, you knock on Nino's neighbor's door. A somewhat frail old lady opens the door.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Hello... Who might you be?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hello, ma'am. I'm... a friend of Nino's.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: A friend of Nino's? Wonderful, our little Nino's finally made a friend in real life... Come in, come in...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: We should celebrate this... Oh yes, here are some cookies she gave me last month. I haven't had the chance to eat them, good timing...
She looks excited, her wrinkled hands waving enthusiastically.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Please don't trouble yourself. I won't bother you for too long.

choices.text: Please don't trouble yourself. I won't bother you for too long.

steps.content: Seeing the woman struggling to open the tin of cookies, you quickly stop her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I happen to be a sheriff and I'm investigating a case related to her. I wanted to ask you a few questions.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, a case? Has she been implicated in some case? Please, you must help her...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry, I can't disclose the specifics of the case to you.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Sigh, I know what kind of person she is, having watched her grow up. That girl may not seem very decent on the outside, but she's in fact quite considerate...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Please don't worry, she's fine. She's been involved in a case and is currently under our protection. Her safety is guaranteed.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, that's good to hear.
The old lady breathes a sigh of relief. She seems to have a really friendly relationship with Nino.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I came here to notify her family. Do you happen to know them?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Sigh, that child is a hard-luck case. She used to live with her grandmother, but after she passed away, Nino has been alone all these years.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What about her parents?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: They left Eastside for Nirvana, where the big corporations and stable jobs are... but...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Nirvana is too far from Eastside, love... They've sacrificed a lot to raise their daughter.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: They hardly come back once a year. Of course, it's not my place to meddle in their family matters... After all, they're doing it for their livelihood.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: That child had no peers of her own age, and she was quiet. She would just lock herself in her room every day.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quiet? That's quite different from the Nino I know.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Sigh... It was before she dyed her hair like that. She used to wear her school uniform all year round.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: It was tough living alone at that age, so I tried to give that child some vegetables I grew myself.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: She refused to take them and even tried to pay me. When I wouldn't accept it, she secretly slipped the money into my mailbox, but I caught her.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: She went off somewhere later. When she came back, she seemed like a different person.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: She dyed her hair and changed her clothes, and she became more talkative... Anyway, it's a good thing that she became more outgoing...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I heard... it was some place on the outskirts of Eastside? She came back with something like a toy sword-shield...
She must have become a Sinner then.
She ran into Corruptors and it was filmed and broadcast to the whole DisCity, then she became a Sinner.
After much deliberation, you're still unsure whether or not to reveal the truth to the kind woman in front of you.
After all, the old woman before you is now the closest thing to Nino's guardian.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: She has indeed changed quite a bit, but when I see that child, I still see the same person despite all the changes in her appearance.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Sometimes I still see her sitting at the door spacing out, just like she always did when she was little.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: A person's demeanor may change, but their true nature often stays the same.
As if talking about her own child, she's introducing you to a Nino you don't know.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: At my age, I've gotten pretty good at reading people. I can tell that you have a complicated past too. Our eyes don't lie.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Haha... We old folks love babbling on and on, don't we? I hope I haven't bored you too much, sheriff?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course not. Please continue.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: A while ago, I heard that she'd finally made some friends, on the... what's it called... internet.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I'm too old to understand all that, but I'm truly glad for her.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: But I'm worried she's too naive and could be deceived by the bad people out there... Don't tell me this is what this case is about...?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Please rest assured. Everything has been properly handled. She's safe now.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, that's good then.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's all the questions I have. Thank you very much for your assistance, have a good day.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Are you sure you don't want some cookies before you leave?
Sometimes it's better to just leave certain things as they are.
The familiar alarm noise echoes over the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We have an emergency. The M-value within the Bureau has exceeded the threshold! Chief, please prepare for immediate action!
Your communication panel opens up automatically and Nightingale's projection appears before you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What is the source of the contamination?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's Sinner Nino.
It happened too fast. You should have reinforced Nino's shackles before going out to investigate the reason she turned into a Sinner.
You thought it was enough to restrain her ability and let her do the livestream under your watch. But that doesn't seem like the case now.
Amid the ear-piercing alarm, you rush into the Bureau without even parking your car properly, and arrive at the room in which Nino is held.
Still... not enough...
Why... won't anyone... spend more time with me...
It's the same with Mom... and Dad... and everyone...
I'm... really... lonely... So lonely...
If we could keep on playing together... how amazing would that be...
A black sphere floats in mid-air in the room and a figure is curled up inside. Although she's dressed differently than usual, you're certain the person inside is Nino.
You can sense a surge of uncontrollable energy filling up the room, pressing in on the almost fully occupied space.
You reach out toward the tough black barrier once again...
